Entity.name: Non-balance sheet recognised financial liability instrument
Entity.comment: Non-balance sheet recognised financial liability accounting standard type distinguishes between Non-balance sheet recognised financial liabilities that are under International Financial Reporting Standard (IFRS) or national general accepted accounting principles (nGAAP).
Entity.commentInRDBMS: A Non-balance sheet recognised financial liability instrument is a Financial liability instrument that is not recognised in the balance sheet (of the reporting agent).

Attribute.name: Non-balance sheet recognised financial liability accounting standard type
Attribute.comment: Non-balance sheet recognised financial liability accounting standard type distinguishes a Non-balance sheet recognised financial liability by the applied accounting standard.
